face.level_is: v17's board reading; nothing is fitted to it (score-feedback rule)
face.note: g is MEASURED on the released LFPG rows of the lit folds, not borrowed from the served average, so the face is this subset's own worth

gate_by_residual_separation.chosen_by: largest fall in RMS(obs_taxi - y) among KEPT rows on the other airports, at a yield of at least 0.5

gate_family.n_ground_points: point count -- the ground points alone
gate_family.seg_dt_median_s: cadence -- the median gap between consecutive points
gate_family.seg_gap_max_s: gaps -- the largest hole in the segment
gate_family.seg_points: point count -- every point of the ground segment
gate_family.stand_stop_s: stop-at-stand -- how long the aircraft sat before it moved

observation_residual.definition: obs_taxi - y_true, in seconds; positive = the clock reads longer than the label

reading: No gate in the pre-declared family beats keeping every row on the other airports: the rejected rows do not carry negative gain, so the quality fields do not separate a broken observation from a usable one on the axis the threshold is allowed to see.

rules.airport_axis: every threshold is set on rows with airport != LFPG
rules.fold_axis: leave-one-fold-out; the ranking cut uses all three folds
rules.label_free: the gate reads only block columns, never y

what: LFPG, section 17 row 4, as a READ before any arm (desk, 2026-09-09).
